exact_statement: Version8 retains prior scoped clauses and adds this supplied-reference theorem. For every Boolean binary mux f=(1-c)G+cH with independent controller a=1-2c, arbitrary fully shared Boolean G,H, and root spectral references Ra,Rg,Rh positive on the true supports, inherit each reference through its own actual physical phase-sensitive pair kernel, retaining all off-target mass and actual reference outcome normalizers. At each history let p=Ec, V=Var(a), gamma=Pr(G!=H), A=Pa conditioned nonempty, beta=1-Ra(empty), B=Ra conditioned nonempty, q=(1-p)Pg+pPh, r=(1-p)Rg+pRh, z_t=(1-p)Ghat(t)+pHhat(t), w_t=V(Ghat(t)-Hhat(t))^2/4. Prescribe Q(empty,t)=r_t z_t^2/q_t and Q(U,t)=r_t(w_t/q_t)B(U) for nonempty U, with all zero-true-row reference mass at empty U. Its actual KL Dstar=D(q||r)+gamma V D(A||B). Set Da=D(Pa||Ra), Cvac=D(Bern(V)||Bern(beta)), W=weighted source KL, Z=W-D(q||r), T=W+gamma Da, S=Z+gamma Cvac. Then Dstar=T-S, S>=0, and T is a supermartingale under every adaptive physical control/data query. For EVERY finite mixed stopping tree, sum reach*(E Dstar_child-Dstar_parent)+sum reach*(T_parent-E T_child)+E S_leaf=S_root. Complete nonnegative entropy or erasure path plus changed-reference terminal CE is <=Hroot+Troot, both child/terminal KL bills retained. Raw output reset equals the signed net debt increment plus actual output erasure/outcome refunds. Root controller empty calibration and common root data reference give Sroot=Jroot exactly, but the ORIGINAL allowance must separately include gamma Da_root; it is not free JS credit or a renewed descendant bank. Genuine source CE and calibrated controller CEplus certificates, plus the scoped v5 surcharge premise, conditionally yield rate max(K+3log2(e),Lg+2p,Lh+2(1-p)). An actual four-variable dummy-DATA-query witness has J=Z=W=0, H=I=2, both source children nonconstant, yet a changed nonempty profile costs (1/4)log2(4/3)>0, refuting arbitrary JS-only payment without refuting FEI.
